findings:
🟠 [allow-bypass] MUST-FIX emitAllowContext() emits permissionDecision "allow" alongside additionalContext; in Claude Code a PreToolUse "allow" bypasses the permission system for that call, so every advisory now auto-approves whatever command it rides on (warn-mode poll/cap breaches, the ambiguous-rows diagnostic, the reserve-entry call, and every 40th no-marker call — e.g. a `curl … | sh` at call 40 runs unprompted). The guard previously only denied or stayed silent; the spec only requires the text to reach the model, not an allow grant. Smallest fix: drop `permissionDecision: 'allow'` from emitAllowContext (emit hookEventName + additionalContext only, normal permission flow continues) and replace the `"permissionDecision":"allow"` assertions in foreman-guard.test.sh and foreman-guard-roles.test.sh with a not-contains on `"deny"`.
🟡 [tmpdir-test-env] MUST-FIX In foreman-guard-roles.test.sh the case `rm -rf ${TMPDIR}/autopilot-p3-safe` is expanded by the test shell; when TMPDIR is unset (the common Linux default, and nothing in the suite sets it) the hook sees `rm -rf /autopilot-p3-safe`, isTmpSafePath returns false, and the assertion "P3 rm under $TMPDIR allowed in reserve" goes red, breaking KR2 acceptance. Smallest fix: `export TMPDIR="$TEST_TMP"` for that block (unset after), and add one single-quoted `'rm -rf $TMPDIR/x'` case so expandTmpdirPrefix is actually exercised.
🔵 [tmp-dotdot] CUT/FOLLOW-UP isTmpSafePath accepts `/tmp/../home/x` (prefix check without normalization); excluded because §6 declares the guard cost discipline, not a security boundary. Follow-up: path.posix.normalize before the prefix test.
🔵 [cmd-subst] CUT/FOLLOW-UP Allowlisted segments with free trailing args admit `$(…)`/backtick substitution (e.g. `git status $(cargo build)`); same §6 rationale and spec says further arguments are free. Follow-up: reject segments containing `$(`, backtick, or `<(`.
🔵 [p1-probe-evidence] CUT/FOLLOW-UP The P1 live additionalContext probe record required under the P0 evidence dir is not in this diff; not a code defect, but confirm the evidence file exists at landing.
🔵 [header-modes-drift] CUT/FOLLOW-UP foreman-guard.js header MODES comment now lists advisory_every but not role_caps / reserve_calls and their env knobs; README and front-door are correct, so this is comment drift only.
